title: Mask Adoption Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing adoption spreads through a population under social influence, information campaigns, availability/cost constraints, and policy mandates.

interactions.name: social_influence
interactions.description: During social contacts, adopters influence non-adopters; individuals update adoption probability based on peers, trust, and message valence.

interactions.name: household_norms
interactions.description: Household-level norms and shared resources affect individual adoption and adherence.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Mandates and enforcement (fines, checks) increase compliance likelihood in locations and public spaces.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks subject to availability and price; retailers update inventory and price.

interactions.name: information_broadcast
interactions.description: Media and policy messaging adjust perceived risk and norms; misinformation can reduce adoption.

interactions.name: location_contacts
interactions.description: People meet at locations with contact rates that drive opportunities for social influence (and optional disease transmission).

interactions.name: mask_distribution
interactions.description: Policymaker distributes free masks to households or individuals, affecting availability and adoption.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Proportion of the population that has adopted mask-wearing at or above a defined adherence threshold.

metrics.name: final_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate at the end of the simulation period.

metrics.name: time_to_50_percent_adoption
metrics.description: Days until overall adoption rate first reaches 50%.

metrics.name: average_adherence
metrics.description: Mean probability of wearing a mask during interactions among adopters.

metrics.name: policy_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to mandates or campaigns (e.g., difference-in-differences before vs. after policy).

metrics.name: adoption_disparity_index
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates across demographic groups (e.g., SES quintiles).

metrics.name: sustained_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Adoption rate measured after policies or campaigns end to assess persistence.

metrics.name: supply_adequacy
metrics.description: Share of days when retailers have non-zero inventory; proxy for availability constraints.

metrics.name: masked_interaction_fraction
metrics.description: Fraction of person-to-person contacts in which at least one party wears a mask.

validation_criteria.name: sanity_no_policy_no_supply_increase
validation_criteria.description: With mandate_start_day null and low inventory, adoption should not exceed initial_adoption_rate by more than a small margin absent strong social influence.

validation_criteria.name: mandate_effect_presence
validation_criteria.description: Under strong enforcement and adequate supply, overall_adoption_rate should exceed 90% within 30 days after a mandate.

validation_criteria.name: non_negative_inventories
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory never becomes negative; purchases cannot exceed available stock.

validation_criteria.name: price_sensitivity_direction
validation_criteria.description: Lower mask_price should weakly increase final_adoption_rate (non-positive price elasticity).

validation_criteria.name: bounded_probabilities
validation_criteria.description: All probabilities (adherence, adoption propensity) remain within [0,1].
